snapshot.stmt: For rational empirical marginals and rational numerical radii \(\varepsilon_{ga}(\alpha),\kappa,d\), \(\mathsf{ProfileTV}\) has a face-complete exact completion by cylindrical algebraic decomposition.  For each \(g\), it returns the real-valued part of \(\mathcal I_{1-\alpha,g}(d)\) as a finite union of closed intervals and isolated real-algebraic points, with an attaining \((p,\mathbf K)\) for every boundary point, and it returns whether \(\bot_{\mathrm{inc}}\) is present.  It returns \(\mathcal D_{1-\alpha}^{\mathrm{all}}\cap[0,1]\) as a finite union of real-algebraic points and intervals with exact open/closed endpoint flags, and returns whether \(+\infty\) is present.  The algorithm terminates after finitely many sign-invariant cells for every rational input, including empty confidence regions, tied active cuts, compatibility boundaries, and sign-radius boundaries.

defs.def:confidence-objects: Let \(\mathcal C_{1-\alpha}^{\kappa}\) contain every \(p\) with \(p_{ga}\in\Delta_4\), \(\|p_{ga}-\widehat p_{ga}\|_1\le\varepsilon_{ga}(\alpha)\), and \(\sum_{z:s_z=1}p_{g1}(z)-\sum_{x:s_x=1}p_{g0}(x)\ge\kappa\), for all \(g,a\). For every such \(p\), set \(\widetilde\Theta_g(d;p)=\Theta_g^{\mathrm{pr}}(d;p)\) if \(\mathfrak K_d(p_{\cdot0},p_{\cdot1})\neq\varnothing\), and \(\widetilde\Theta_g(d;p)=\{\bot_{\mathrm{inc}}\}\) otherwise. Define \(\mathcal I_{1-\alpha}(d)=(\bigcup_{p\in\mathcal C_{1-\alpha}^{\kappa}}\widetilde\Theta_g(d;p))_{g\in\mathcal G}\) and \(\mathcal D_{1-\alpha}^{\mathrm{all}}=\{\delta_{\mathrm{sign}}^{\mathrm{all}}(p):p\in\mathcal C_{1-\alpha}^{\kappa}\}\).
defs.def:robust-kernel-class: \(\mathfrak K_d(\mu^0,\nu)=\{\mathbf K: k_x\in\Delta_4\ \forall x\in\mathcal X,\ k_{gx}\in\Delta_4\ \forall g\in\mathcal G,x\in\mathcal X,\ \operatorname{TV}(k_{gx},k_x)\le d\ \forall g\in\mathcal G,x\in\mathcal X,\ \sum_{x\in\mathcal X}\mu_g^0(x)k_{gx}=\nu_g\ \forall g\in\mathcal G\}\).
defs.def:psace-objects: \(\Theta_g^{\mathrm{pr}}(d)=\{N_g^{\mathrm{pr}}(\mathbf K)/D_g^{\mathrm{pr}}(\mathbf K):\mathbf K\in\mathfrak K_d(\mu^0,\nu)\}\), with \(L_g^{\mathrm{pr}}(d)=\min\Theta_g^{\mathrm{pr}}(d)\) and \(U_g^{\mathrm{pr}}(d)=\max\Theta_g^{\mathrm{pr}}(d)\) when this set is nonempty.

defs.def:profiling-handle: Introduce variables for \(p_{g0}(x)k_{gx}(z)\), impose McCormick envelopes on recursively partitioned simplex boxes, retain direct simplex and rowwise total-variation constraints, solve nodewise Charnes--Cooper and sign-constrained relaxations, and branch on the product with the largest certified envelope gap.

snapshot.stmt: For every \((\mu^0,\nu)\in\mathcal W_{\epsilon_{\mathrm w}}\), Wu--Mao's exact transportability model identifies \(K^0=M^{-1}N\) and \(\Theta_1^{\mathrm{pr}}(0)=\{\theta_1^{\mathrm{WM}}\}\). For every \(0<d\le\bar d=10^{-2}\), the rowwise-TV model obeys the two strict inclusions \[\{\theta_1^{\mathrm{WM}}\}=\Theta_1^{\mathrm{pr}}(0)\subsetneq\Theta_1^{\mathrm{pr}}(d)\subsetneq\Theta_1^{\mathrm{ST}}.\] Both strict gaps hold uniformly over this nondegenerate observable class.

defs.def:rational-witness: Order states as \((0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)\). Set \(\mu^{\mathrm w}=10^{-1}\begin{pmatrix}7&1&1&1\\1&7&1&1\\1&1&7&1\\1&1&1&7\end{pmatrix}\), \(K^{\mathrm w}=40^{-1}\begin{pmatrix}2&2&18&18\\2&2&18&18\\1&1&19&19\\1&1&19&19\end{pmatrix}\), \(\nu^{\mathrm w}=\mu^{\mathrm w}K^{\mathrm w}\), and \(J^{\mathrm{alt}}=200^{-1}\begin{pmatrix}9&9&71&51\\0&0&20&0\\0&0&0&20\\0&0&0&20\end{pmatrix}\). The tuple of these four rational arrays is \(W^*\).
defs.def:single-trial-benchmark: For \(\mathfrak J_g=\{J_g\in\mathbb R_+^{4\times4}:\sum_zJ_g(x,z)=\mu_g^0(x),\ \sum_xJ_g(x,z)=\nu_g(z)\}\), let \(\Theta_g^{\mathrm{ST}}\) be the range of \([\sum_{x:s_x=0,z:s_z=1}(y_z-y_x)J_g(x,z)]/[\sum_{x:s_x=0,z:s_z=1}J_g(x,z)]\) over \(J_g\in\mathfrak J_g\).

snapshot.stmt: The observed-arm identification lemma and conditional multinomial concentration imply \(\Pr\{(\mu^0,\nu)\in\mathcal C_{1-\alpha}^{\kappa}\}\ge1-\alpha\). The set-inclusion lemma therefore gives simultaneous finite-sample coverage for all augmented PSACE fibers and \(\delta_{\mathrm{sign}}^{\mathrm{all}}\). The interval hull of each finite projected fiber covers both sharp endpoints whenever the true fixed-radius class is compatible. Coverage remains valid at tied cuts, at \(d\in\{0,1\}\), under incompatibility, and at \(+\infty\).
